name: Thai Sikh Run (31st ed.)
short_description: The 31st Thai Sikh Run is a half marathon, 10 km and 4 km event on Burapha Road beside The Old Siam Plaza in Bangkok, Thailand, on 31 January 2027.
ai_summary: The 31st Thai Sikh Run is set for Sunday 31 January 2027 on Burapha Road beside The Old Siam Plaza in Bangkok, Thailand. It is organised by Sri Guru Singh Sabha, the Sikh temple community that started the race in 1992, and offers a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km and a non-competitive 4 km walk-run. The 30th edition on 1 February 2026 drew 4,800 runners.

core_facts.venue: Burapha Road, The Old Siam Plaza, Bangkok

pros: Cheap entry: 700 baht for the 2026 half marathon, 600 for the 10 km
AIMS-certified half marathon and 10 km through Bangkok's old city
Three and a half hours for the half, with water and first aid every 2 km
Trophies run deep: in 2026 a sub-two-hour woman or a sub-1:32 man won one
Post-race food and drink included in every entry
cons: Very humid: dew point 23°C at the 3.30am start and 94% humidity from 5am in 2026
No refunds or transfers, even if the race is cancelled or postponed
Single out-and-back, so the second half repeats the first

faqs.question: When is the Thai Sikh Run taking place?
faqs.answer: Sunday 31 January 2027, on Burapha Road beside The Old Siam Plaza in Bangkok. This is the 31st edition. In 2026 the half marathon started at 3.30am, the 10 km at 4.30am and the 4 km walk-run at 5.15am, and race packs were collected the day before at the Sikh temple.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Thai Sikh Run?
faqs.answer: Three: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km and a non-competitive 4 km walk-run. In 2026 the cut-offs were three and a half hours for the half marathon, two and a half hours for the 10 km and one hour 45 minutes for the 4 km, and only the half included a finisher T-shirt.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Thai Sikh Run?
faqs.answer: Sri Guru Singh Sabha, the Sikh temple community in Bangkok, organises the Thai Sikh Run. It first held the race in 1992 with a 10 km and a 5 km walk, added the half marathon on the 20th anniversary, and the 21.1 km and 10 km courses were AIMS-certified in 2020.
